hooks.hook_text: I saw your 2024 Global FinTech Series interview where you highlighted payments networks integrating with apps and crypto.
hooks.rationale: As CFO, you're responsible for operational efficiency and cost control; expanding into app wallets and crypto creates complex reconciliation workloads that a finance leader needs to streamline.
hooks.bridge: Our platform automates the manual, reconciliation‑heavy processes that arise from those integrations, letting your finance team focus on strategic initiatives.

hooks.hook_text: Your bio notes you built financial operating systems that scaled Dama Technology to $6 B in annual volume and led a $65 M acquisition.
hooks.rationale: Scaling to billions of transactions generates massive manual reconciliation workloads, a direct pain point for a CFO overseeing finance operations and post‑acquisition integration.
hooks.bridge: We help CFOs automate those reconciliation tasks, reducing errors and operational overhead as you continue to grow.

hooks.hook_text: The team page lists you as CFO alongside a CTO, CRO, and VP of Operations, underscoring a cross‑functional leadership group.
hooks.rationale: Being part of a senior team driving platform growth means you need seamless data flow between finance, product, and operations—areas where manual reconciliation can become a bottleneck.
hooks.bridge: Our solution creates a unified, automated reconciliation layer that keeps finance in sync with product and ops, supporting your collaborative initiatives.

hooks.hook_text: Congratulations on appointing Jamison Jaworski as CRO in your recent Business Wire release.
hooks.rationale: A new CRO signals accelerated revenue initiatives, which will increase transaction volume and consequently the reconciliation workload your finance team must manage.
hooks.bridge: Our automation platform scales with transaction growth, ensuring your finance team can handle the surge without added manual effort.
